entities.summary: The Archaeological Museum of Casentino "Piero Albertoni" is a museum located in Bibbiena, Italy. It occupies the historic site of Palazzo Niccolini, which also represents the seat of the town hall. The museum houses, divided into five rooms, a collection of archaeological objects ranging from Prehistory to the Middle Ages, found over the years in the Casentino region.
